1.consolidated_definition: beb. Con hielo. Se dice de la bebida espiritosa a la que se le añade hielo. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Mis amigas y yo llevábamos tiempo queriendo organizar una cocktail party, y voilà, con las recetas en mano, nos pondremos manos a la obra sumergiendo cada mezcla on the rocks , ya sabéis, con hielos (Fashion is not a Luxury, 24-09-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: On the rocks: adj. With ice. Said of a spirituous drink to which ice is added. Raw anglicism, commonly used. My friends and I had been wanting to organize a cocktail party for some time, and voilà, with the recipes in hand, we will get started by immersing each mixture on the rocks, you know, with ice (Fashion is not a Luxury, 24-09-08)
